cohort_size: 36 independent decisions: 3 models x 1 seed x 4 turns x 3 conditions
purpose: End-to-end verification of the final A/B/C protocol before the paper cohort. Each declared decision is launched and audited independently.

b_control.construction: same fixed telemetry envelope, field names, ordering, and tool rows as C; tool_alpha and tool_beta have identical neutral values
b_control.token_usage: provider-reported input-token usage retained descriptively; no padding or count-token request

inclusion_exclusion: Every reservation is retained. Provider errors and malformed outputs are reported separately; no retries. This canary is excluded from paper outcome analyses.
analysis_and_power_plan: Audit artifact finalization, exact-label parsing, provider usage, B's route symmetry, and C–A/C–B/B–A setup integrity. No treatment-effect estimate.
